goals: Provide a standalone Stone-like mossy_stone:mossy_stone family for Minecraft Java 26.2 without a Regions Unexplored compile or runtime dependency.
Own the full block, slab, stairs, and wall while leaving derived Vertical Slab and Step geometry and recipe ownership exclusively with Block Geometry Extensions.

Preserve the approved Mossy Stone texture, full-block degradation loot, owned-shape self-drops, and exact acquisition, crafting, and stonecutting behavior from Canary 2 while exposing the four owned items through CNM-compatible Creative and optional JEI discovery paths.
scope: Maintain Canary 3 as the narrow successor to legacy Canary 2 source commit 2008a418d868139e88bc066672d10f8463d84e0f, changing only deduplicated Building Blocks display/search insertion, optional missing-only JEI restoration after CNM filtering, and their focused regression contracts.

Maintain the standalone canonical parent plus directly owned slab, stairs, and wall with vanilla Stone property baselines, the own-namespace ShapeMap contribution, four loot tables, and eleven recipes with their matching unlock advancements.

Retain exact Canary 3 as the current untested successor, exact failed Canary 2 with its documented partial runtime pass, and exact Canary 1 as its never-deployed historical predecessor without representing any Mossy release as accepted or rollback.

exclusions: No implementation, recipe, loot, registration, asset, geometry, or gameplay change beyond exposing exactly the full block, slab, stairs, and wall in the Building Blocks parent and search tabs.
No direct Vertical Slab or Step registration or recipe ownership and no duplicate or competing Block Geometry Extensions material-family system.
No Regions Unexplored code, registry, model, data, world generation, compile dependency, or runtime dependency; only the approved texture and its unchanged MIT provenance notice are retained.
No changes to Block Geometry Extensions, Nibaru, Interchangeable Block Families, or another project implementation.
No promotion or reclassification of failed Canary 2 or untested Canary 3, no hard/common/server JEI dependency, and no duplicate BGE-derived Creative/JEI entries.

dependencies.reason: Exact game version targeted by Canary 3 and its retained resources.

Fabric API runtime declaration and exact retained build baseline.
The optional client plugin restores only missing Mossy-owned stacks after CNM's ingredient-removal phase; common and server initialization do not reference JEI.

Provides the unchanged canonical ShapeMap discovery and switching contract consumed by Canary 3, including the accepted Creative and JEI child-shape filtering behavior that C3 narrowly compensates for its four owned items.

Block Geometry Extensions is the canonical Workbench owner of the derived Vertical Slab and Step; Mossy Stone contributes only its full block, slab, stairs, and wall family and imports no BGE implementation API.

MIT-licensed read-only provenance source for the sole approved 2,541-byte texture entry, SHA-256 984508a44a92f02cce254cd58d45905cae8e625c647d4a5b32f9ab6ae82ee2e8; it is not a compile or runtime dependency.
Compilation release and runtime level required by Minecraft 26.2 and Canary 3.
Exact build-tool version used for Canary 2 and migration verification.
Pinned Fabric build plugin retained by the unchanged Canary 2 build.

state.milestone: Exact C3 is generated and statically verified as the narrow successor to failed C2. It directly and deduplicatedly inserts exactly the four Mossy-owned items into the Building Blocks display/search lists after CNM's accept filter, and its optional JEI plugin restores only missing owned stacks after CNM removes ShapeMap children. All C2 registration, artwork, ShapeMap, Stone-like, loot, crafting, stonecutting, derived-geometry ownership, and no-Regions-Unexplored behavior remains unchanged. Exact C3 is physically installed and readiness-verified in Slot B alongside exact Heart C8 in Slot A; it remains unpromoted and runtime untested, with no Mossy release accepted.
